scientific_integrity: All general claims have an analytic proof; finite rational computations are auxiliary. Originality rests on inspected published comparisons, not an independent priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only distinct multiplicatively dependent integer bases and strictly positive per-digit weights. Noncommensurable bases and weights with zeros are not classified; no quantitative separation rate is claimed.
title: Primitive-digit rigidity and mutual singularity across commensurable dice bases
